messages:
elaine: Quick triage: Acme listing kickoff — need network/KMS/roles for AWS & GCP, plus Azure offer registry. Who can spin up a preflight checklist? Need to sync with legal on EULA/POC trial terms. /cc @claire-legal

mike: I got AWS. Send publisher account ID and VPC CIDR ranges. KMS key policy needs to allow Redwood-managed role. I can produce IAM role mapping. ETA today.

sam: Product here — SKU mapping is mostly final (developer / enterprise). Trial = 14d, seats = per-org. Need legal to confirm telemetry/data-collection copy and whether trial provisioning can use marketplace SaaS flow.

claire-legal: Sharing draft: https://docs.internal/repo/acme-eula-draft.md. Two quick items: (1) confirm data residency + encryption-at-rest expectations (KMS) and (2) will Acme require a reseller clause for marketplace sales? If yes, I need their legal contact.

jordan: Azure update — publisher registration pending but I have preliminary publisherId: 987654321. Need offerId/planId and a sample ARM template for the manifest. Also confirm if Acme wants trial auto-provisioning via marketplace SaaS (we'll need redirect URI and callback).

mike: Sample AWS KMS policy I recommend for initial testing (replace publisher ARN):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Sid": "AllowRedwoodMarketplaceRole",
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::555555555555:role/RedwoodMarketplaceRole"},
    "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
    "Resource": "*"
  }]
}
```
Use the publisher account ARN instead of 555555555555. For IAM, I'll export a trust policy mapping soon.

sam: @mike — perfect. For the public listing we need a one-line crypto blurb: "Customer data encrypted at rest with customer KMS key (optional)." I'll draft the short and long copy and attach.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created checklist ticket #MKP-412 in partnerships board (https://boards.internal/issue/MKP-412) and assigned to @mike/@jordan/@sam/@claire-legal.

elaine: Plan of record: mike -> AWS KMS + IAM role by EOD; jordan -> Azure manifest bits + publisher confirmation by EOD; sam -> packaging copy + trial flow draft by EOD; claire-legal -> final legal comments by EOD. Sync standup 09:30 PST tomorrow. If blockers, ping here. :thumbsup:
